overview_description.description: Hugging Face is an AI and machine learning platform for collaborating on models, datasets, and applications. It provides tools and libraries for developing, training, sharing, and deploying machine learning models across text, image, video, audio, and 3D applications. The platform also offers compute, inference, enterprise, and hosting services for teams and developers.
